transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because my sleep has really fallen apart. I lie awake for hours, even with my laptop closed, just mentally going over work deadlines, tuition payments, and class assignments. And when I do sleep, I wake up feeling like I never actually switched off.
Aside from when you are trying to sleep, do you find yourself feeling anxious or worrying about these things during the day as well?

Yes, all day. My mind keeps jumping from whether I’m falling behind at work, to whether I’m wasting money on school, to whether my family thinks I can’t handle things. Even small problems feel like they could derail my whole future.
About how many months have you been feeling this constant, daily worry?
About a year and three months now—since I started the evening graduate certificate program while keeping my full-time analyst job.
Over this past year, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed most of the day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve been so focused on everything I need to keep up with that it’s hard to separate feeling down from just feeling overwhelmed.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?

Yeah, I have. I used to do yoga, go running, and cook pretty regularly, and I’ve mostly stopped doing all of that. I’m falling behind on work deadlines and in my classes too—it feels like I don’t have the energy or space for the things I used to enjoy.
Do you find it difficult to control or stop these worries once they start?

Yes. I try to tell myself to stop and just focus on one thing, but then one worry leads right into another. I end up checking my calendar, budget, and assignments over and over instead of actually getting anything done.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or blaming yourself excessively for things?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought of it in those terms.
Have you noticed physical tension in your body, such as tight or aching muscles in your neck, shoulders, or back?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t specifically noticed tightness or aching in those areas.
Do you often find yourself feeling restless, keyed up, or on edge?
I’m not sure what you mean by “keyed up.” I do feel worried a lot, but I haven’t really noticed whether I’m physically restless or on edge.
Have you noticed yourself feeling more easily annoyed or irritable with other people lately?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed whether I’ve been more irritable with people lately.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or finding that your mind goes blank?

Yes. I’ll be looking at a financial model or something I need to read and realize I’ve gone over the same paragraph five times without taking any of it in. My mind is already going through everything that could go wrong.
Do you find that you feel fatigued or tire much more easily than usual?

Yes. By midafternoon at work I feel completely drained. Even answering emails or walking to the subway feels like it takes a lot of effort, and resting over the weekend doesn’t really bring my energy back.
